title: Dancing Shrimp: Favorite Thai Recipes for Seafood
description: All about Dancing Shrimp - a cookbook of Thai seafood cookery, by Kasma Loha-unchit.
author: Kasma Loha-unchit
body:
Kasma's first cookbook was It Rains Fishes: Legends, Traditions and the Joys of Thai Cooking.

Dancing Shrimp, published by Simon & Schuster is a book of Kasma's favorite Thai Recipes for Seafood including both traditional Thai recipes and Kasma's original recipes. It contains a wealth of information on how to work with a variety of fish, shellfish and mollusks. One chapter contains detailed information about all of the ingredients used in the book – Kasma's husband thinks this chapter alone makes the book worth owning. As with her previous book, It Rains Fishes, the detailed cooking methods,instructions and recipes are woven into a tapestry of cultural imagery, folklore and personal impressions of the country where Kasma grew up.

Dancing Shrimp: Favorite Thai Recipes For Seafood by: Kasma Loha-unchit, Simon & Schuster, October 2000 (304 pages, $30.00), Hardcover, ISBN: 0-684-86272-7.

Although now out of print, you should still be able to find a second-hand copy at many places where used books are sold.

I have been a fan of Kasma Loha-unchit's since first reading her award-winning It Rains Fishes. In Dancing Shrimp she once again gives us a jewel with enchanting prose, extensive information, and delightful recipes.

         – Nina Simonds, author of A Spoonful of Ginger

See also  Reviews of Dancing Shrimp.

Table of Contents

  1. Introduction – The Story of Dancing Shrimp
  2. Thai Cooking Basics (includes Cooking "to Taste")
  3. A Seafood Culture
  4. Preserved Foods and Flavoring Ingredients from the Sea – Sample selection.
  5. Ingredients and Tips for Selection and Preparation – Sample selection.
  6. Techniques and Equipment
  7. Fish (including recipes – see below)
  8. Crustaceans (including recipes – see below)
  9. Mollusks (including recipes – see below)

There are a total of 92 recipes.

Fish recipes include:

  • Hot-and-Sour, Pan-fried Trout Soup with Roasted Chillies and Aromatic Herbs
  • Lime-Cooked Halibut Dressed with Roasted Chilli Sauce, Toasted Coconut and Peanuts
  • Braised Whole Tilapia with Ginger and Green Onions
  • Crisped Catfish Salad with Sour Green Mango and Peanuts or Cashews
  • Curried Mousse of Red Snapper in Banana Leaf Cups
  • Charcoal-Grilled Spiced Fish in Banana Leaf Packets
  • Garlic-Peppered Pompano
  • Catfish Rounds Simmered in Turmeric-Flavored Coconut Sauce
  • Garlic-Black Bean Pan-Fried Red Snapper
  • Mesquite-Grilled-and-Smoked Fish with Piquant Sour Tamarind Sauce
  • Pan-Fried Mackerel and Assorted Vegetables with Hot-and-Pungent Fermented Shrimp Dipping Sauce

Crustacean recipes include:

  • Hot-and-Sour Shrimp Salad with Roasted Chilli Sauce, Lemon Grass and Mint
  • Crispy Shrimp-and-Crab Toast with Sesame Seeds Served with Sweet-and-Sour Plum Sauce
  • Dancing Shrimp
  • Country-Style Hot-and-Sour Prawn Soup with Aromatic Herbs and Oyster Mushrooms
  • Savory Shrimp Cakes Served with Sweet-and-Sour Cucumber Relish
  • Charcoal-Grilled Jumbo Prawns or Lobster Tails Topped with Sour Tamarind Sauce
  • Hot-and-Sour Lemon Grass Tiger Prawns
  • Fried Crab Cakes
  • Black-Peppered Crab with Roasted Spices

Mollusk and Mixed Seafood Dishes include:

  • Clams Stir-fried with Roasted Chilli Sauce and Basil
  • Crispy Shrimp-and-Crab-Stuffed Squid
  • Stuffed Squid Soup with Napa Cabbage or Squash
  • Crispy Shrimp-and-Crab-Stuffed Squid
  • Sizzling Stir-fried Squid with Chillies and Fragrant Herbs
  • Squid Sauted with Garlic and Lime
  • Clam and Mussel Coconut Lime Soup with Oyster Mushrooms
  • Shellfish Salad with Aromatic Thai Herbs, Crisped Shallots and Garlic, and Sweet-and-Sour Chilli Dressing
  • Marinated Mesquite-Grilled Scallops Served with Sweet-and-Tangy Dipping Sauce
  • Curried Mussels on the Half Shell with Flaked Crab
  • Mixed Seafood Salad with Lemon Grass, Mint and Chilli-Lime Dressing

Order Information:

Dancing Shrimp is currently out of print. It originally was published in Fall 2000 by Simon & Schuster. The cover price was $30.00 (hardcover) plus state sales tax, where applicable. Although now out of print, you should still be able to find a second-hand copy at many places where used books are sold.
